structure: CSharp branch/tap stages use ordinary flow inference/emission, including scalar container queries. Parallel branch now preserves one target descriptor per stage with an optional callable function; readonly zero-argument intrinsic queries require no callable symbol. Shared ResolveLocal loads actual readonly capture headers instead of placeholders.
branches: Sequential entry and ordinary function, parallel readonly source and named owner terminal tap. Preserve effectful/async/move/mutable-argument restrictions; readonly query stages have no function callbacks or extra parameters.
logic: Current Native branch arm finalizers and branchStageFlowIndex enumerate only kind6 declared calls. Tap finalization binds kind6 and println opcodes only. Check actual intrinsic IR and bind the same primary/previous-stage value and terminal result for all resolved junction stages.
diagnostics: Preserve exact CSharp S003 fixed-length warnings for the new dynamic-array probes; do not suppress them. New parallel query positive is supported after CSharp semantic/capture fixes.
implementationDecision: CSharp EmitParallelBranchCallback installs an empty local scope and then only transported source/captures; ResolveLocal cannot see the original caller slots. Native callbacks pass ownerIndex=-1 to ordinary query emitters but unscoped mutableStorageRoot can still find caller IR bindings. Introduce one query storage resolver that requires a current emitting owner; otherwise query emitters consume the already-transported canonical SSA value. Use it for length, capacity, BitSet count and Arena query reads. Preserve mutation storage checks and existing positive-owner behavior.
productTypeRootCause: Actual len expression and arm IR are Int, but the product declaration still has UIntSize for its second field. resolvePaths skips an already-created branch product even after its terminal target type becomes canonical. Its existing reintern/update branch is unreachable under that outer guard. Recompute branch products from final canonical arm types in each changed dependency round; retain separate immutable product identities instead of mutating the old field table.
readonlyQueryDispatch: Native dispatch reuses len, capacity, BitSet count and only Arena used (raw operation2), matching CSharp zero-argument readonly query admission. Other raw Arena operations cannot enter this query adapter.
capacityRootCause: Current len/parallel/tap positives4 pass; capacity JunctionTarget has no canonical scalar result because recursive query dispatch has no capacity rule. The branch therefore has no completed product. The S003 operation walker also only visits ordinary flow kind10 and uses an AST child receiver; extend it to consume the same canonical junction source AST. CSharp capacity returns Int for collections, UIntSize for Arena and marks a growable requirement. Preserve exact empty stderr for the capacity probe and original249 genuine S003.
additionalControl: Test-only parallel capacity CFG control; actual source comparison48 and Native51 inputs are unchanged, no SLG edit or new compiler build.
mutableOwnerConcern: CSharp readonly query reads the actual borrowed source value. Native callback transports that value, but ordinary query emitters can still resolve the original mutable binding and print its caller-local slot. ownerIndex is-1 in callbacks; no caller-local storage is in that LLVM scope. Reproduce length/control and capacity before changing any source.
sharedPolicyDecision: CSharp input overlap, target async/effect admission and readonly-query names now come from FunctionTypeBindingPolicy. Its actual compiled methods generate the separate SLG policy. Native source-fact adapters and diagnostic selection will call these same policy methods, preserve CSharp mode/target/argument checks, and report the same labels, paths and locations before LLVM.
